name: Camp Klondike
source: Ahhh, summer camp - where the only thing that sucks more than the mosquitos are the campers. But when those little critters go home, it's time for the counselors to play. Imagine a world of pine trees, lakes, and campfires. Seven sun-drenched days and star-kissed nights where a summer's worth of yearning boils to the surface. Yikes! Camp Klondike is a fun-filled VN where anything could happen... if the counselors could just get up the nerve to do what they've been secretly dreaming about in their bunks. Will they? Will you?
translation: 啊，夏令营——那里唯一比蚊子更吸引人的是露营者。但当这些小动物回家后，辅导员们就该玩耍了。想象一个有松树、湖泊和篝火的世界。七个阳光普照的白天和星光闪烁的夜晚，对夏天的渴望浮出水面。哎呀！克朗代克营是一个充满乐趣的越南，任何事情都有可能发生……如果辅导员们能鼓起勇气去做他们在铺位上一直秘密梦想的事情。他们会吗？你会？
